segments.1SA.26.5-5: David sees where Saul and Abner are sleeping
segments.1SA.26.6-8: Abishai wants to kill sleeping Saul with the spear
segments.1SA.26.9-10: David tells Abishai not to kill Saul
segments.1SA.26.11-12: David takes Saul’s spear and water jug and leaves
segments.1SA.26.13-14: David calls out to Abner from the mountain
segments.1SA.26.15-16: David accuses Abner of not protecting the king
segments.1SA.26.17-18: Saul knows David’s voice; David asks why Saul chases him
segments.1SA.26.19-20: David asks Saul to stop hunting him
segments.1SA.26.21-21: Saul admits his sin and asks David to come back
segments.1SA.26.22-23: David returns the spear and trusts the LORD to repay
segments.1SA.26.24-25: David asks the LORD to value his life; Saul blesses him
segments.1SA.27.1-1: David decides to escape to the land of the Philistines
segments.1SA.27.2-4: David and his men live in Gath, and Saul stops searching
segments.1SA.27.5-7: Achish gives David the town of Ziklag
segments.1SA.27.8-9: David raids the Geshurites, Girzites and Amalekites
segments.1SA.27.10-10: David tells Achish he raided places in Judah
segments.1SA.27.11-12: Achish trusts David, who leaves no one alive
segments.1SA.28.1-2: Achish says David and his men must fight Israel
segments.1SA.28.5-6: Saul is afraid, and the LORD does not answer him
segments.1SA.28.7-7: Saul’s servants tell him of a medium at Endor
segments.1SA.28.8-10: Saul disguises himself and asks the medium for a spirit
segments.1SA.28.13-14: The woman sees Samuel, and Saul bows down
segments.1SA.28.15-15: Saul tells Samuel that God no longer answers him
segments.1SA.28.16-17: Samuel says the LORD has given the kingdom to David
segments.1SA.28.18-19: Samuel says Saul and his sons will die tomorrow
segments.1SA.28.20-21: Saul falls down in fear, weak from not eating
segments.1SA.28.22-23: The woman and servants urge Saul to eat
segments.1SA.28.24-25: The woman cooks a meal for Saul and his servants
segments.1SA.29.1-2: The Philistines gather, and David marches with Achish
segments.1SA.29.3-3: Achish defends David to the Philistine commanders
segments.1SA.29.4-4: The commanders tell Achish to send David back
segments.1SA.29.5-5: The commanders remind Achish of the song about David
segments.1SA.29.6-7: Achish tells David to go home in peace
segments.1SA.29.8-9: David asks why he cannot go to battle with Achish
segments.1SA.29.10-11: David and his men go back early in the morning
segments.1SA.30.1-2: The Amalekites burn Ziklag and take the people captive
segments.1SA.30.3-4: David and his men find Ziklag burned and weep
segments.1SA.30.5-6: David is greatly distressed but finds strength in the LORD
segments.1SA.30.7-8: The LORD tells David to pursue the raiders
segments.1SA.30.9-10: David leaves two hundred tired men at Besor
segments.1SA.30.11-12: David’s men find and feed a starving Egyptian
segments.1SA.30.13-14: The Egyptian says he was a slave of an Amalekite
segments.1SA.30.15-15: The Egyptian promises to lead David to the raiders
segments.1SA.30.16-17: David defeats the Amalekites; four hundred escape
segments.1SA.30.18-20: David recovers everything the Amalekites had taken
segments.1SA.30.21-22: Wicked men refuse to share plunder with the tired men
segments.1SA.30.23-25: David says all the men will share the plunder alike
segments.1SA.30.26-28: David sends plunder to the elders of Judah
segments.1SA.30.29-31: David sends gifts to friends in more towns
segments.1SA.31.1-3: The Philistines defeat Israel and kill Saul’s sons
segments.1SA.31.4-6: Saul and his armor-bearer kill themselves
segments.1SA.31.9-10: The Philistines hang Saul’s body at Beth-shan
